smoke.expr: (async () => { const a = await window.aibox.download.availability({}); if (!a || !a.available) throw new Error('download engine unavailable: ' + JSON.stringify(a)); return 'engine ok' })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().includes('添加')); if (!b) throw new Error('add entry point missing'); b.click(); return 'opened' })()
['应用内', 'iCloud', '外部文件夹', '笔记 Vault'].every(t => document.body.innerText.includes(t))

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('textarea'); if (!t) throw new Error('url field missing'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(t, 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/git/git/master/README.md'); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'url entered' })()

(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '开始下载'); if (!b) throw new Error('submit button missing or disabled'); b.click(); return 'submitted' })()

(async () => { const tasks = await window.aibox.download.list({}); if (!tasks.length) throw new Error('nothing was enqueued'); const done = tasks.find(t => t.state === 'completed'); if (!done) throw new Error('no completed download yet: ' + tasks.map(t => t.state + ' ' + (t.fraction||0)).join(', ')); if (!done.outputPath) throw new Error('completed but no outputPath — the file did not land'); return 'downloaded to ' + done.outputPath })()

isolation.expr: (function(){ window.__iso='pending'; window.aibox.download.list({}).then(t => { const bad = t.filter(x => x.owner && !x.owner.startsWith('applet:')); window.__iso = bad.length ? ('LEAK ' + JSON.stringify(bad.map(x => x.owner))) : ('scoped ok, ' + t.length + ' own tasks') }); return 'fired' })()
